title: Protocol for cell surface biotinylation of magnetic labeled and captured human peripheral blood mononuclear cells
protocol: Dilute 10 mL of blood with DPBS supplemented with 2% FBS at a 1:1 ratio.
Add 15 mL of lymphocyte separation medium (Ficoll-Paque) into the SepMate tube.
Carefully layer the diluted blood sample onto the Ficoll-Paque media solution by slowly adding it while tilting the tube horizontally.
Centrifuge the mixture at 1200 × g for 10 minutes.
Transfer the upper part of the separated cells from the SepMate to a new falcon tube.
Adjust the volume with DPBS to 50 mL and centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 minutes.
Label target cells with magnetic beads.
Incubate the cell suspension with CD34 and CD45 microbeads at +4°C for 15 minutes, rotating slowly.
Wash cells by adding 2 mL labeling buffer and centrifuge at 125 × g for 10 minutes.
Place the LS MACS column on the magnetic separator and rinse with 2 mL MACS buffer.
Add labeled cells into the MACS column; unlabeled cells will flow through.
Wash cells once with 3 mL MACS buffer.
Wash cells three times with PBS.
Ensure that the MACS buffer is thoroughly washed from the column using PBS if necessary.
Place a 15 mL Falcon tube to collect the flow-through solution and add the biotinylation solution into the column.
Take the flow-through (biotinylation solution) and add it back to the column again.
Repeat this process at least 10 times.
Apply 2 ml TBS buffer into the column to quench the biotinylation reaction.
Repeat the TBS wash 3 times.
Add 2 ml MACS buffer to the column.
Remove the column from the magnetic separator.
Plunge the column into the collection tube to elute the surface biotinylated cells.
Take 75 μL from eluted cells obtained in step C6 to validate biotinylation.
Take 106 cells from non-biotinylated CD34+ CD45+ PBMCs into a separate tube as a control for non-specific streptavidin binding.
Take another 106 cells from non-biotinylated CD34+ CD45+ PBMCs into a separate tube to set the auto-fluorescent threshold.
Adjust all cell suspensions to 100 μL with PBS.
Add 3 μL of streptavidin-FITC to each 100 μL of cells and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes in the dark.
Add 2 μL of 7-AAD to each sample and incubate at room temperature for 2-3 minutes.
Complete the volume of each sample to 2 mL with PBS.
Analyze the samples using a flow cytometry instrument.
Check that over 80% of cells are FITC positive and 7-AAD negative; if not, do not proceed further.
Centrifuge the cells obtained from step 25 at 125 × g for 10 min.
Add protease inhibitor (2% v/v) to the 500 μL RIPA lysis buffer and dissolve the cell pellet.
Pipette the mixture at least 20 times to improve cell lysis efficiency.
Incubate the cells on ice for 30 min, vortexing every 10 min for dispersion and disruption of the cell pellet.
Centrifuge the cell lysate at 15000 × g for 10 min at +4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a clean collection tube.
Use protein low-bind tubes after this step.
Wash the 75 μL streptavidin resin with 500 μL PBS.
Centrifuge the washed resin at 1000 × g for 1 min.
Repeat washing with 100 μL lysis buffer and centrifuge at 1000 × g for 1 min.
Combine the streptavidin resin with cell lysate.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for an hour on a rotator mixer.
Centrifuge the mixture at 1000 × g for 1 min.
Discard or store unbound proteins in the supernatant.
Wash the resin with 100 μL lysis buffer and centrifuge at 1000 × g for 1 min.
Wash the beads with 1 mL PBS and centrifuge at 1000 × g for 1 min.
Repeat washing with 1 mL PBS three times.
Suspend the resin in 300 μL 0.2% (w/v) RapiGest solution containing TEAB.
Add TCEP to the solution at a final concentration of 20 mM.
Add IAA to the solution at a final concentration of 40 mM.
Incubate the mixture at 60°C for 30 min and cool on ice.
Add 200 ng Lys-C to the resin mixture.
Incubate overnight at 37°C.
Add 800 ng Trypsin-Gold to the resin after Lys-C incubation.
Incubate for 4 h at 37°C.
Centrifuge the resin at 10000 g for 1 min.
Transfer the supernatant into a low-bind collection tube.
Acidify the sample with TFA (1% final concentration).
Activate the Stage Tips with 250 μL In-Stage conditioning buffer.
Equilibrate the Stage Tips with 250 μL In-Stage washing buffer.
Load the acidified samples into the Stage Tips.
Wash peptide-bounded tips with washing buffer three times.
Add 50 μL In-Stage elution buffer to the peptides.
Elute the peptides using a syringe and apply pressure on the In-Stage tips.
Dry the eluate with a vacuum concentrator.
Store the dried eluate at −20°C.
Dissolve dried samples in 12 μL of sample solution (5% ACN, 0.1% Formic Acid).
Sonicate samples in an ultrasonic water bath for 1 minute.
Centrifuge samples at 15000 × g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer supernatant into insert-vials.
Inject 4 μL of peptide mixture in a trap elute mode.
Separate peptide mixture using a reverse phase analytical column.
Identify peptides using a high-resolution mass spectrometry instrument.
